headlines.title: MO Lifts 2026 EPS Outlook as Pricing Offsets Cigarette Volume Declines
headlines.summary: Altria raises its 2026 EPS outlook as strong cigarette pricing offsets falling shipments, while nicotine pouch growth and NJOY ACE's absence remain challenges.

headlines.title: MO Stock Jumps 10.3% in 3 Months as Pricing Power Supports Earnings
headlines.summary: Altria shares gained 10.3% in three months as pricing power and higher earnings guidance fueled gains, but elevated valuation raises questions about upside.

headlines.title: Is MO Stock a Buy Now as Earnings Strength Meets Valuation Pressure?
headlines.summary: Altria's resilient earnings and strong pricing support profits, but cigarette-volume declines and a valuation near five-year highs raise questions for investors.

headlines.title: Will Altria's Smoke-Free Business Become Its Next Growth Engine?
headlines.summary: MO's expanding on! nicotine pouch portfolio, rising shipments and product innovation bolster its smoke-free ambitions, but profitability challenges persist.

headlines.title: Altria: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
headlines.summary: Cigarette profits are funding a pivot to smoke-free products, but regulatory delays and illicit competition threaten the transition.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
